stem: After a stock reduction, a Voltmarkt category's inventory turnover rose from 6 to 9 times a year, while its stockout rate went from 2% to 7%. Which reading is best?

options.text: The stock works harder, but the cut may be costing sales through empty shelves
The cut was a clear success, because a higher turnover means better stock control
The turnover must be wrong, since less stock means fewer units can be sold
The stockout rate rose because turnover counts out-of-stock days as sales
